{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSrziJfxWK6jsYBqVvw4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load CSV Reader\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Shared reader that opens a CSV file named on the command line, checks its header, and returns numbered rows. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md |\n| Provides | ledger_core.csvio |\n| Consumes | ledger, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nThe three `ledger load <table> <csv>` commands share one reader so that file handling, header\nchecking, and the exit codes for unreadable files and malformed rows are identical. The reader\nonly reads: it never touches the database and never writes.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, header)`\n\n- `path` is the file path named on the command line; `header` is the sequence of column names the\n  table requires, in order.\n- Returns a list of `(line_number, fields)` tuples, one per data row, in file order. `line_number`\n  is the 1-based line of the file (the header is line 1, so the first data row is line 2). `fields`\n  is a list of strings exactly as parsed by the `csv` module.\n- A file that is missing or cannot be read or decoded raises `Operational` (exit 1).\n- A header that differs from `header` in names or order, an empty file, or a data row whose field\n  count differs from `len(header)` raises `Rejected` (exit 3), with a diagnostic naming the line.\n- A file with a valid header and no data rows returns an empty list.\n- Blank lines are not data rows and are skipped.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC csvio-reads-numbered-rows ===\nIntent: read_rows returns every data row in file order with 1-based file line numbers and the parsed fields, for a file whose header matches.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nrows = [[\"ZZR1\", \"First Row\"], [\"ZZR2\", \"Second Row\"], [\"ZZR3\", \"Third Row\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    got = read_rows(path, header)\n    assert len(got) == len(rows)\n    for i, (line_no, fields) in enumerate(got):\n        assert line_no == i + 2\n        assert list(fields) == rows[i]\n=== END AC csvio-reads-numbered-rows ===\n\n=== AC csvio-header-only-is-empty ===\nIntent: a file with a matching header and no data rows yields an empty list rather than an error.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"category\", \"description\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow(header)\n    assert list(read_rows(path, header)) == []\n=== END AC csvio-header-only-is-empty ===\n\n=== AC csvio-missing-file-operational ===\nIntent: an unreadable path raises the Operational error, which the CLI maps to exit 1.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"does-not-exist.csv\")\n    try:\n        read_rows(path, [\"account\", \"name\"])\n    except Exception as exc:\n        assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Operational\"\n    else:\n        raise AssertionError(\"expected Operational\")\n=== END AC csvio-missing-file-operational ===\n\n=== AC csvio-bad-header-rejected ===\nIntent: a header with the wrong names, the wrong order, or no content raises Rejected, which the CLI maps to exit 3.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nbad_headers = [[\"name\", \"account\"], [\"account\"], [\"account\", \"name\", \"extra\"], [\"code\", \"name\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    for i, bad in enumerate(bad_headers):\n        path = os.path.join(d, f\"bad{i}.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow(bad)\n        try:\n            read_rows(path, header)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for header %r\" % (bad,))\n    empty = os.path.join(d, \"empty.csv\")\n    open(empty, \"w\").close()\n    try:\n        read_rows(empty, header)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n    else:\n        raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for an empty file\")\n=== END AC csvio-bad-header-rejected ===\n\n=== AC csvio-wrong-field-count-rejected ===\nIntent: a data row with too few or too many fields raises Rejected even when the header is valid.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nbodies = [\"ZZR1\\n\", \"ZZR1,Name,Extra\\n\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    for i, body in enumerate(bodies):\n        path = os.path.join(d, f\"row{i}.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            fh.write(\",\".join(header) + \"\\n\" + body)\n        try:\n            read_rows(path, header)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for body %r\" % body)\n=== END AC csvio-wrong-field-count-rejected ===\n\n=== AC csvio-load-missing-file-exit-1 ===\nIntent: through the CLI, a load naming an unreadable file exits 1, writes nothing to stdout, and stores nothing.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"missing.csv\")\n    with db_session() as db:\n        before = len(db.accounts.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 1\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n=== END AC csvio-load-missing-file-exit-1 ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The reader never writes to the database or to any file.\n- The reader never opens a database driver.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only; nothing is written to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Accounts\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load accounts <csv>` as an all-or-nothing bulk load. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load accounts |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.csvio, ledger_core.validation, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad accounts from a CSV file whose header is `account,name`. Every row is validated before the\nfirst write; the rows are then written together or not at all.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger load accounts <csv>` takes exactly one file argument; other counts exit 2.\n2. Read the file with `ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, (\"account\", \"name\"))`. An unreadable file\n   exits 1; a wrong header or wrong field count exits 3.\n3. Validate every row before any write: the code is 1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`, the name is 1\n   to 40 characters with no comma or newline, the code does not repeat within the file, and the code\n   is not already stored.\n4. Insert every row in one atomic unit. A failure at any row leaves every earlier row unstored.\n5. Print `table,loaded` then `accounts,<rows>`, where `<rows>` is the number of rows inserted.\n6. Any rejection exits 3 with nothing on standard output and one diagnostic line on standard error.\n   A header-only file loads zero rows and prints `accounts,0`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-005` — read: list stored accounts to detect duplicate keys - supplies: — - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-success ===\nIntent: a valid accounts file loads every row, prints the declared two CSV rows with the loaded count, and the rows are readable afterward.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nrows = [[\"ZZLAA1\", \"Load One\"], [\"ZZLAA2\", \"Load Two\"], [\"ZZLAA3\", \"Load Three\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(rows))]]\n        for acct, name in rows:\n            row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n            assert row is not None\n            got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n            assert got == name\n=== END AC load-accounts-success ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\nIntent: when the last row is invalid, exit 3 is returned, stdout is empty, and none of the earlier valid rows is stored.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [[\"ZZLB%d\" % i, \"Good %d\" % i] for i in range(1, 11)]\nbad = [\"zzlbbad\", \"Lowercase Code\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(good)\n        w.writerow(bad)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        before = len(db.accounts.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n        for acct, _ in good:\n            assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-invalid-fields ===\nIntent: each invalid code or name (too long, empty, bad characters, comma in name) rejects the whole file with exit 3 and stores neither it nor the valid row before it.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nfirst = [\"ZZLCOK\", \"Valid First\"]\nbad_rows = [\n    [\"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"Code Too Long\"],\n    [\"ZZLC-1\", \"Bad Char Code\"],\n    [\"\", \"Empty Code\"],\n    [\"ZZLC2\", \"\"],\n    [\"ZZLC3\", \"x\" * 41],\n    [\"ZZLC4\", \"has,comma\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        for i, bad in enumerate(bad_rows):\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"a%d.csv\" % i)\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n                w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n                w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n                w.writerow(first)\n                w.writerow(bad)\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n            assert code == 3, bad\n            assert out == \"\"\n            assert db.accounts.get(account=first[0]) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-invalid-fields ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-duplicates-rejected ===\nIntent: a code repeated inside the file, and a code already stored, each reject the whole file with exit 3 and leave the other rows unstored.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        p1 = os.path.join(d, \"dup_in_file.csv\")\n        write(p1, [[\"ZZLD1\", \"One\"], [\"ZZLD2\", \"Two\"], [\"ZZLD1\", \"One Again\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", p1)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD1\") is None\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD2\") is None\n\n        stored = \"ZZLD3\"\n        stored_name = \"Already Stored\"\n        db.accounts.create(account=stored, name=stored_name)\n        p2 = os.path.join(d, \"dup_stored.csv\")\n        write(p2, [[\"ZZLD4\", \"Fresh\"], [stored, \"Replacement\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", p2)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD4\") is None\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=stored)\n        got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n        assert got == stored_name\n=== END AC load-accounts-duplicates-rejected ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-header-and-usage ===\nIntent: a wrong header exits 3 with nothing stored, and a missing file argument is a usage error with exit 2.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"wrong_header.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"code\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([\"ZZLE1\", \"Wrong Header\"])\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLE1\") is None\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\")\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC load-accounts-header-and-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No row is written until every row in the file has been validated.\n- Seed files are never read by application code; the file path comes only from the command line.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load categories <csv>` as an all-or-nothing bulk load. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load categories |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.csvio, ledger_core.validation, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad categories from a CSV file whose header is `category,description`, applying the same\nvalidate-everything-then-write rule as the accounts load.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger load categories <csv>` takes exactly one file argument; other counts exit 2.\n2. Read the file with `ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, (\"category\", \"description\"))`. An\n   unreadable file exits 1; a wrong header or wrong field count exits 3.\n3. Validate every row before any write: the code is 1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`, the description\n   is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline, the code does not repeat within the file, and the\n   code is not already stored.\n4. Insert every row in one atomic unit; a rejection stores none of them.\n5. Print `table,loaded` then `categories,<rows>`.\n6. Any rejection exits 3 with nothing on standard output and one diagnostic line on standard error.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-005` — read: list stored categories to detect duplicate keys - supplies: — - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-001` — write: create a category - supplies: `category`, `description` - returns: `category`, `description`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-categories-success ===\nIntent: a valid categories file loads every row, prints the declared two CSV rows with the loaded count, and the rows are readable afterward.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nrows = [[\"ZZKA1\", \"Cat One\"], [\"ZZKA2\", \"Cat Two\"], [\"ZZKA3\", \"Cat Three\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"categories.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(rows))]]\n        for cat, text in rows:\n            row = db.categories.get(category=cat)\n            assert row is not None\n            got = row[\"description\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.description\n            assert got == text\n=== END AC load-categories-success ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\nIntent: when a later row is invalid, exit 3 is returned, stdout is empty, and none of the earlier valid rows is stored.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [[\"ZZKB%d\" % i, \"Good %d\" % i] for i in range(1, 6)]\nbad = [\"ZZKBBAD\", \"x\" * 41]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"categories.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n        w.writerows(good)\n        w.writerow(bad)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        before = len(db.categories.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.categories.list()) == before\n        for cat, _ in good:\n            assert db.categories.get(category=cat) is None\n=== END AC load-categories-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-invalid-fields ===\nIntent: each invalid code or description (bad characters, empty, over length, comma) rejects the whole file with exit 3 and stores no row.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nfirst = [\"ZZKCOK\", \"Valid First\"]\nbad_rows = [\n    [\"zzkc1\", \"Lowercase\"],\n    [\"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"Too Long Code\"],\n    [\"\", \"Empty Code\"],\n    [\"ZZKC2\", \"\"],\n    [\"ZZKC3\", \"has,comma\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        for i, bad in enumerate(bad_rows):\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"c%d.csv\" % i)\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n                w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n                w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n                w.writerow(first)\n                w.writerow(bad)\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n            assert code == 3, bad\n            assert out == \"\"\n            assert db.categories.get(category=first[0]) is None\n=== END AC load-categories-invalid-fields ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-duplicates-rejected ===\nIntent: a code repeated inside the file, and a code already stored, each reject the whole file with exit 3 and leave the stored row unchanged.\nRequires: executable=python3; the file path comes only from the command line.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with full validation and the balance rule checked before any write. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRule.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.csvio, ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.balances, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad transactions from a CSV file whose header is `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`.\nEach row keeps the `txn_id` from the file. The file is accepted entirely or not at all.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger load transactions <csv>` takes exactly one file argument; other counts exit 2.\n2. Read the file with `ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"))`.\n   An unreadable file exits 1; a wrong header or wrong field count exits 3.\n3. Validate every row before any write: `txn_id` is an integer, not repeated in the file and not\n   already stored; the date is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`; the account and category exist in\n   the store; the amount matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has at most two decimals, and is not zero; the\n   memo is 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline. Amounts are converted to integer cents\n   without floating point.\n4. Apply `ledger_core.balances.check_no_negative` to all rows together as inserts. The effect of\n   the whole file is considered at once, so a withdrawal that precedes its funding deposit in the\n   file is accepted when the final balance is not below zero. A resulting negative balance for any\n   account rejects the file.\n5. Insert every row in one atomic unit, then print `table,loaded` and `transactions,<rows>`.\n6. Any rejection exits 3, writes nothing to standard output, and stores none of the rows.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm each referenced account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm each referenced category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: detect an already stored txn_id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>` and the shared `account_row` helper. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add, ledger_core.accounts |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.money, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCreate one account and print its row. The module `ledger_core.accounts` also exports the helper the\nother account commands use to build an account row from live data.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger account add <code> <name>` takes exactly two arguments; other counts exit 2.\n2. Validate the code (1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`) and the name (1 to 40 characters, no comma or\n   newline). A violation exits 3.\n3. A code that is already stored exits 3 and leaves the stored account unchanged.\n4. Insert the account, then print CSV: the header `account,name,transactions,balance` and one row\n   with the new account, its name, `0` transactions, and balance `0.00`.\n5. A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger_core.accounts.account_row(db, code)` returns `None` when the account is absent, otherwise\nthe tuple `(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)` where `transactions` is the number of that\naccount's stored transactions and `balance_cents` is the integer sum of their amounts. Both are\ncomputed from the database on every call. Formatting the balance as text is done by\n`ledger_core.money.format_cents` in the command, not in the helper.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: get an account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list an account's transactions to count and sum them - supplies: `account` - returns: `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-success ===\nIntent: adding a new account exits 0, prints the header and one row with zero transactions and a zero balance, and the account reads back from the store.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZNA1\"\nname = \"Add Probe\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert parsed[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert parsed[1] == [acct, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    assert len(parsed) == 2\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    assert row is not None\n    got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n    assert got == name\n=== END AC account-add-success ===\n\n=== AC account-add-duplicate-rejected ===\nIntent: adding a code that already exists exits 3, prints nothing, and leaves the stored name unchanged.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZNB1\"\noriginal = \"Original Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, original)\n    assert code == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, \"Different Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n    assert got == original\n=== END AC account-add-duplicate-rejected ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: lowercase letters, a code longer than 12 characters, a bad character, and an empty code each exit 3 with no output and store no account.\nRequires: executable=python3; BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load CSV Reader\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Shared reader that opens a CSV file named on the command line, checks its header, and returns numbered rows. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md |\n| Provides | ledger_core.csvio |\n| Consumes | ledger, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nThe three `ledger load <table> <csv>` commands share one reader so that file handling, header\nchecking, and the exit codes for unreadable files and malformed rows are identical. The reader\nonly reads: it never touches the database and never writes.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, header)`\n\n- `path` is the file path named on the command line; `header` is the sequence of column names the\n  table requires, in order.\n- Returns a list of `(line_number, fields)` tuples, one per data row, in file order. `line_number`\n  is the 1-based line of the file (the header is line 1, so the first data row is line 2). `fields`\n  is a list of strings exactly as parsed by the `csv` module.\n- A file that is missing or cannot be read or decoded raises `Operational` (exit 1).\n- A header that differs from `header` in names or order, an empty file, or a data row whose field\n  count differs from `len(header)` raises `Rejected` (exit 3), with a diagnostic naming the line.\n- A file with a valid header and no data rows returns an empty list.\n- Blank lines are not data rows and are skipped.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC csvio-reads-numbered-rows ===\nIntent: read_rows returns every data row in file order with 1-based file line numbers and the parsed fields, for a file whose header matches.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nrows = [[\"ZZR1\", \"First Row\"], [\"ZZR2\", \"Second Row\"], [\"ZZR3\", \"Third Row\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    got = read_rows(path, header)\n    assert len(got) == len(rows)\n    for i, (line_no, fields) in enumerate(got):\n        assert line_no == i + 2\n        assert list(fields) == rows[i]\n=== END AC csvio-reads-numbered-rows ===\n\n=== AC csvio-header-only-is-empty ===\nIntent: a file with a matching header and no data rows yields an empty list rather than an error.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"category\", \"description\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow(header)\n    assert list(read_rows(path, header)) == []\n=== END AC csvio-header-only-is-empty ===\n\n=== AC csvio-missing-file-operational ===\nIntent: an unreadable path raises the Operational error, which the CLI maps to exit 1.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"does-not-exist.csv\")\n    try:\n        read_rows(path, [\"account\", \"name\"])\n    except Exception as exc:\n        assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Operational\"\n    else:\n        raise AssertionError(\"expected Operational\")\n=== END AC csvio-missing-file-operational ===\n\n=== AC csvio-bad-header-rejected ===\nIntent: a header with the wrong names, the wrong order, or no content raises Rejected, which the CLI maps to exit 3.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nbad_headers = [[\"name\", \"account\"], [\"account\"], [\"account\", \"name\", \"extra\"], [\"code\", \"name\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    for i, bad in enumerate(bad_headers):\n        path = os.path.join(d, f\"bad{i}.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow(bad)\n        try:\n            read_rows(path, header)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for header %r\" % (bad,))\n    empty = os.path.join(d, \"empty.csv\")\n    open(empty, \"w\").close()\n    try:\n        read_rows(empty, header)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n    else:\n        raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for an empty file\")\n=== END AC csvio-bad-header-rejected ===\n\n=== AC csvio-wrong-field-count-rejected ===\nIntent: a data row with too few or too many fields raises Rejected even when the header is valid.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n\nheader = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nbodies = [\"ZZR1\\n\", \"ZZR1,Name,Extra\\n\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    for i, body in enumerate(bodies):\n        path = os.path.join(d, f\"row{i}.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            fh.write(\",\".join(header) + \"\\n\" + body)\n        try:\n            read_rows(path, header)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            assert type(exc).__name__ == \"Rejected\"\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError(\"expected Rejected for body %r\" % body)\n=== END AC csvio-wrong-field-count-rejected ===\n\n=== AC csvio-load-missing-file-exit-1 ===\nIntent: through the CLI, a load naming an unreadable file exits 1, writes nothing to stdout, and stores nothing.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"missing.csv\")\n    with db_session() as db:\n        before = len(db.accounts.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 1\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n=== END AC csvio-load-missing-file-exit-1 ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The reader never writes to the database or to any file.\n- The reader never opens a database driver.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only; nothing is written to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Accounts\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load accounts <csv>` as an all-or-nothing bulk load. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load accounts |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.csvio, ledger_core.validation, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad accounts from a CSV file whose header is `account,name`. Every row is validated before the\nfirst write; the rows are then written together or not at all.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger load accounts <csv>` takes exactly one file argument; other counts exit 2.\n2. Read the file with `ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, (\"account\", \"name\"))`. An unreadable file\n   exits 1; a wrong header or wrong field count exits 3.\n3. Validate every row before any write: the code is 1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`, the name is 1\n   to 40 characters with no comma or newline, the code does not repeat within the file, and the code\n   is not already stored.\n4. Insert every row in one atomic unit. A failure at any row leaves every earlier row unstored.\n5. Print `table,loaded` then `accounts,<rows>`, where `<rows>` is the number of rows inserted.\n6. Any rejection exits 3 with nothing on standard output and one diagnostic line on standard error.\n   A header-only file loads zero rows and prints `accounts,0`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-005` — read: list stored accounts to detect duplicate keys - supplies: — - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-success ===\nIntent: a valid accounts file loads every row, prints the declared two CSV rows with the loaded count, and the rows are readable afterward.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nrows = [[\"ZZLAA1\", \"Load One\"], [\"ZZLAA2\", \"Load Two\"], [\"ZZLAA3\", \"Load Three\"]]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(rows))]]\n        for acct, name in rows:\n            row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n            assert row is not None\n            got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n            assert got == name\n=== END AC load-accounts-success ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\nIntent: when the last row is invalid, exit 3 is returned, stdout is empty, and none of the earlier valid rows is stored.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [[\"ZZLB%d\" % i, \"Good %d\" % i] for i in range(1, 11)]\nbad = [\"zzlbbad\", \"Lowercase Code\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(good)\n        w.writerow(bad)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        before = len(db.accounts.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n        for acct, _ in good:\n            assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-rejected-row-stores-nothing ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-invalid-fields ===\nIntent: each invalid code or name (too long, empty, bad characters, comma in name) rejects the whole file with exit 3 and stores neither it nor the valid row before it.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nfirst = [\"ZZLCOK\", \"Valid First\"]\nbad_rows = [\n    [\"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"Code Too Long\"],\n    [\"ZZLC-1\", \"Bad Char Code\"],\n    [\"\", \"Empty Code\"],\n    [\"ZZLC2\", \"\"],\n    [\"ZZLC3\", \"x\" * 41],\n    [\"ZZLC4\", \"has,comma\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        for i, bad in enumerate(bad_rows):\n            path = os.path.join(d, \"a%d.csv\" % i)\n            with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n                w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n                w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n                w.writerow(first)\n                w.writerow(bad)\n            code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n            assert code == 3, bad\n            assert out == \"\"\n            assert db.accounts.get(account=first[0]) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-invalid-fields ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-duplicates-rejected ===\nIntent: a code repeated inside the file, and a code already stored, each reject the whole file with exit 3 and leave the other rows unstored.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        p1 = os.path.join(d, \"dup_in_file.csv\")\n        write(p1, [[\"ZZLD1\", \"One\"], [\"ZZLD2\", \"Two\"], [\"ZZLD1\", \"One Again\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", p1)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD1\") is None\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD2\") is None\n\n        stored = \"ZZLD3\"\n        stored_name = \"Already Stored\"\n        db.accounts.create(account=stored, name=stored_name)\n        p2 = os.path.join(d, \"dup_stored.csv\")\n        write(p2, [[\"ZZLD4\", \"Fresh\"], [stored, \"Replacement\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", p2)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLD4\") is None\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=stored)\n        got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n        assert got == stored_name\n=== END AC load-accounts-duplicates-rejected ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-header-and-usage ===\nIntent: a wrong header exits 3 with nothing stored, and a missing file argument is a usage error with exit 2.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"wrong_header.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"code\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([\"ZZLE1\", \"Wrong Header\"])\n    with db_session() as db:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ZZLE1\") is None\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\")\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC load-accounts-header-and-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No row is written until every row in the file has been validated.\n- Seed files are never read by application code; the file path comes only from the command line.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with full validation and the balance rule checked before any write. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCsvReader.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRule.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.csvio, ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.balances, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad transactions from a CSV file whose header is `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`.\nEach row keeps the `txn_id` from the file. The file is accepted entirely or not at all.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger load transactions <csv>` takes exactly one file argument; other counts exit 2.\n2. Read the file with `ledger_core.csvio.read_rows(path, (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"))`.\n   An unreadable file exits 1; a wrong header or wrong field count exits 3.\n3. Validate every row before any write: `txn_id` is an integer, not repeated in the file and not\n   already stored; the date is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`; the account and category exist in\n   the store; the amount matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, has at most two decimals, and is not zero; the\n   memo is 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline. Amounts are converted to integer cents\n   without floating point.\n4. Apply `ledger_core.balances.check_no_negative` to all rows together as inserts. The effect of\n   the whole file is considered at once, so a withdrawal that precedes its funding deposit in the\n   file is accepted when the final balance is not below zero. A resulting negative balance for any\n   account rejects the file.\n5. Insert every row in one atomic unit, then print `table,loaded` and `transactions,<rows>`.\n6. Any rejection exits 3, writes nothing to standard output, and stores none of the rows.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm each referenced account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm each referenced category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: detect an already stored txn_id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-transactions-success ===\nIntent: a valid file loads every row keeping its txn_id, prints the declared two Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZMA1\", \"ZZMC1\"\nrows = [\n    [\"920000001\", \"2026-01-02\", acct, cat, \"100.50\", \"deposit\"],\n    [\"920000002\", \"2026-01-03\", acct, cat, \"-20.25\", \"withdrawal\"],\n    [\"920000003\", \"2026-01-04\", acct, cat, \"7\", \"\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"txns.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Category\")\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\n        for tid, day, a, c, amt, memo in rows:\n            row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(tid))\n            assert row is not None\n            g = (lambda n: row[n]) if isinstance(row, dict) else (lambda n: getattr(row, n))\n            assert g(\"date\") cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZMG1\", \"ZZMC7\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"wrong_header.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n        w.writerow([\"920000600\", \"2026-09-01\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"\"])\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Category\")\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=920000600) is None\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", os.path.join(d, \"missing.csv\"))\n        assert code == 1\n        assert out == \"\"\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\")\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC load-transactions-header-and-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No row is written until every row has passed validation and the balance rule.\n- Amounts are integer cents; floating point is never used for money.\n- The file's `txn_id` values are kept; none is renumbered.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountAdd.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>` and the shared `account_row` helper. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add, ledger_core.accounts |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.money, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCreate one account and print its row. The module `ledger_core.accounts` also exports the helper the\nother account commands use to build an account row from live data.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `ledger account add <code> <name>` takes exactly two arguments; other counts exit 2.\n2. Validate the code (1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9`) and the name (1 to 40 characters, no comma or\n   newline). A violation exits 3.\n3. A code that is already stored exits 3 and leaves the stored account unchanged.\n4. Insert the account, then print CSV: the header `account,name,transactions,balance` and one row\n   with the new account, its name, `0` transactions, and balance `0.00`.\n5. A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger_core.accounts.account_row(db, code)` returns `None` when the account is absent, otherwise\nthe tuple `(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)` where `transactions` is the number of that\naccount's stored transactions and `balance_cents` is the integer sum of their amounts. Both are\ncomputed from the database on every call. Formatting the balance as text is done by\n`ledger_core.money.format_cents` in the command, not in the helper.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: get an account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list an account's transactions to count and sum them - supplies: `account` - returns: `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-success ===\nIntent: adding a new account exits 0, prints the header and one row with zero transactions and a zero balance, and the account reads back from the store.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZNA1\"\nname = \"Add Probe\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert parsed[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert parsed[1] == [acct, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    assert len(parsed) == 2\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    assert row is not None\n    got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n    assert got == name\n=== END AC account-add-success ===\n\n=== AC account-add-duplicate-rejected ===\nIntent: adding a code that already exists exits 3, prints nothing, and leaves the stored name unchanged.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZNB1\"\noriginal = \"Original Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, original)\n    assert code == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, \"Different Name\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n    assert got == original\n=== END AC account-add-duplicate-rejected ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: lowercase letters, a code longer than 12 characters, a bad character, and an empty code each exit 3 with no output and store no account.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_codes = [\"zznc1\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"ZZ-NC\", \"ZZ NC\", \"\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.accounts.list())\n    for bad in bad_codes:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Valid Name\")\n        assert code == 3, bad\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-name ===\nIntent: an empty name, a name over 40 characters, and a name containing a comma each exit 3 with no output and store no account.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZND1\"\nbad_names = [\"\", \"n\" * 41, \"has,comma\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_names:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, bad)\n        assert code == 3, bad\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-name ===\n\n=== AC account-add-boundary-lengths ===\nIntent: a 12-character code and a 40-character name are the largest accepted values and are stored whole.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"Z\" * 12\nname = \"n\" * 40\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, name)\n    assert code == 0\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=acct)\n    assert row is not None\n    got = row[\"name\"] if isinstance(row, dict) else row.name\n    assert got == name\n=== END AC account-add-boundary-lengths ===\n\n=== AC account-add-usage-errors ===\nIntent: the wrong number of arguments is a usage error with exit 2 and no output.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nfor args in ((\"account\", \"add\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\"), (\"account\", \"add\", \"ZZNE1\", \"Name\", \"Extra\")):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2, args\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC account-add-usage-errors ===\n\n=== AC account-row-helper ===\nIntent: account_row reports the live transaction count and the integer-cent balance computed from stored transactions, and None for an absent account.\nRequires: executable=python3; scope=test\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZNF1\", \"ZZNFC\"\nname = \"Helper Probe\"\namounts = [10000, -2550, 1]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=name)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Helper Category\")\n    for i, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=930000000 + i, date=\"2026-03-01\", account=acct,\n                               category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n    row = account_row(db, acct)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert tuple(row) == (acct, name, len(amounts), sum(amounts))\n    assert account_row(db, \"ZZNFNONE\") is None\n=== END AC account-row-helper ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Validation completes before the insert; a rejected add changes nothing.\n- The balance is integer cents in the helper and is formatted only for output.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===","ttft_ms":25619,"type":"result","duration_ms":110843,"uuid":"540d2884-01c4-4b5c-8219-8a8ac9935491","ttft_stream_ms":4658,"time_to_request_ms":570,"first_content_frame_ms":4658,"queued_turn_count":0,"result_index":0,"model_usage_since_last_result":{"claude-sonnet-5-5":{"inputTokens":2,"outputTokens":19775,"cacheReadInputTokens":1545,"cacheCreationInputTokens":104122,"webSearchRequests":0,"costUSD":0.6143965,"contextWindow":1000000,"maxOutputTokens":128000,"thinkingTokens":2476,"cacheCreationEphemeral5mInputTokens":0,"cacheCreationEphemeral1hInputTokens":104122,"canonicalModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","provider":"firstParty","costBasis":"list"}}}
